instructions: If A1a = NO → automatically set A1b = NO and go to A2a
If A2a = NO → automatically set A2b = NO and go to A3a_recent
If A1b OR A2b = YES → explore BOTH current and past episodes (A3* → A4 → A5 → A6a)
If A1b AND A2b = NO → explore ONLY past-episode items (A3*_past → A4_past → A5 → A6a)
Count each A3 group as positive if ANY of its two items = YES
Assess A4 separately for current and past episodes
If A5 = YES → code ‘recurrent’ (must have ≥2-month symptom-free interval)
Diagnosis: ≥5 symptom groups (A3a–A3g) positive AND core symptom (A1b or A2b) positive AND A4 positive AND organic causes ruled out

questions.prompt: Were you ever depressed or down, or felt sad, empty or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks?
For the past two weeks, were you depressed or down, or felt sad, empty or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?
Were you ever much less interested in most things or much less able to enjoy the things you used to enjoy most of the time, for two weeks?
Were you ever much less interested in most things or much less able to enjoy the things you used to enjoy most of the time, for two weeks?
In the past two weeks, were you much less interested in most things or much less able to enjoy the things you used to enjoy most of the time?
In the past 2 weeks, was your appetite decreased or increased nearly every day, or did your weight change by ±5% without trying?
In the past 2 weeks, have you had trouble sleeping nearly every night (trouble falling asleep, waking early, or sleeping excessively)?
In the past 2 weeks, did you find yourself speaking or moving more slowly than usual, or feeling restless or fidgety nearly every day? Did anyone notice?
In the past 2 weeks, have you felt tired or had very little energy almost every day?
In the past 2 weeks, have you felt worthless or guilty almost every day?
Can you describe the kind of guilt or worthlessness you felt? For example, did you feel you deserved punishment, caused disasters, or had a disease or illness you didn’t?
In the past two weeks, have you had trouble concentrating, thinking clearly, or making decisions almost every day?
In the past 2 weeks, have you repeatedly thought about death, had thoughts or plans to harm yourself, or attempted suicide?

I’ll now ask the same questions again, but about any *past episodes*.

A *past episode* means a time earlier in your life when you felt depressed or lost interest in things most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks — and may have had other symptoms like trouble sleeping, low energy, or appetite change.

For each question, just think about whether that specific symptom happened during that kind of period. You don’t need to recall every symptom — just the ones I ask about.
In a past episode, have you experienced a noticeable change in appetite almost every day, or an unintentional weight change of around 5%?
In a past episode, did you have sleep problems nearly every night?
In a past episode, did you talk or move more slowly than normal, or were you restless/fidgety almost every day?
In a past episode, did you feel the same lack of energy almost every day?
In a past episode, did you feel the same way — worthless or guilty almost every day?
Can you describe the kind of guilt or worthlessness you felt? For example, did you feel you deserved punishment, caused disasters, or had a disease or illness you didn’t?
In a past episode, did you have similar problems with concentration or decision-making almost every day?
In a past episode, did you ever have similar thoughts or actions related to death or suicide?
During the past 2 weeks, have these symptoms caused significant distress or problems and marked a change from your usual functioning?
During a past episode, did these symptoms cause significant distress or problems and mark a change from your usual functioning?
Between depressive episodes, did you ever have at least 2 months without significant depression or loss of interest?
How many episodes of depression have you had in your lifetime? (Only count if at least 2 months passed between episodes.)
Were you taking any drugs or medicines or in withdrawal from any of these? I am trying to understand if the symptoms you have described could be caused by other organic factors.
Did you have any other medical illness unrelated to the one we discussed today? I am trying to understand if the symptoms you have described could be caused by other organic factors.

positive: At least 5 symptom groups (A3a–A3g) coded YES
Core symptom: A1a=YES or A2a_1=YES or A2a_2=YES or A1b=YES or A2b=YES
